1: // Void Runner – simple endless canvas game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth;
8:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight;
9: 
10:   const keys = {};
11:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
12:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
13: 
14:   const rand = (a, b) => Math.random() * (b - a) + a;
15:   const dist = (a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y);
16: 
17:   // ---- Player ----
18:   const ship = {
19:     x: width / 2,
20:     y: height / 2,
21:     r: 12,
22:     angle: 0,
23:     vx: 0,
24:     vy: 0,
25:     fuel: 100,
26:     thrust: 0.15,
27:     turnSpeed: 0.07,
28:     maxSpeed: 4,
29:     update() {
30:       if (keys['ArrowLeft']) this.angle -= this.turnSpeed;
31:       if (keys['ArrowRight']) this.angle += this.turnSpeed;
32:       if (keys['ArrowUp'] && this.fuel > 0) {
33:         this.vx += Math.cos(this.angle) * this.thrust;
34:         this.vy += Math.sin(this.angle) * this.thrust;
35:         this.fuel = Math.max(0, this.fuel - 0.2);
36:       }
37:       // limit speed
38:       const speed = Math.hypot(this.vx, this.vy);
39:       if (speed > this.maxSpeed) {
40:         this.vx *= this.maxSpeed / speed;
41:         this.vy *= this.maxSpeed / speed;
42:       }
43:       this.x += this.vx;
44:       this.y += this.vy;
45:       // wrap around edges
46:       if (this.x < 0) this.x += width;
47:       if (this.x > width) this.x -= width;
48:       if (this.y < 0) this.y += height;
49:       if (this.y > height) this.y -= height;
50:     },
51:     draw() {
52:       ctx.save();
53:       ctx.translate(this.x, this.y);
54:       ctx.rotate(this.angle);
55:       ctx.beginPath();
56:       ctx.moveTo(this.r, 0);
57:       ctx.lineTo(-this.r, this.r / 2);
58:       ctx.lineTo(-this.r, -this.r / 2);
59:       ctx.closePath();
60:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
61:       ctx.fill();
62:       ctx.restore();
63:     }
64:   };
65: 
66:   // ---- Asteroids ----
67:   const asteroids = [];
68:   const spawnAsteroid = () => {
69:     const angle = rand(0, Math.PI * 2);
70:     const speed = rand(0.5, 2);
71:     const radius = rand(15, 30);
72:     const side = Math.floor(rand(0, 4)); // 0:left,1:top,2:right,3:bottom
73:     let x, y;
74:     if (side === 0) { x = 0; y = rand(0, height); }
75:     else if (side === 1) { x = rand(0, width); y = 0; }
76:     else if (side === 2) { x = width; y = rand(0, height); }
77:     else { x = rand(0, width); y = height; }
78:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed, vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed, r: radius });
79:   };
80: 
81:   // ---- Orbs ----
82:   const orbs = [];
83:   const spawnOrb = () => {
84:     const radius = 6;
85:     const x = rand(radius, width - radius);
86:     const y = rand(radius, height - radius);
87:     orbs.push({ x, y, r: radius, collected: false });
88:   };
89: 
90:   // initial spawns
91:   for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) spawnAsteroid();
92:   for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) spawnOrb();
93: 
94:   let score = 0;
95:   let gameOver = false;
96: 
97:   const update = () => {
98:     if (gameOver) return;
99:     ship.update();
100:     // move asteroids
101:     for (const a of asteroids) {
102:       a.x += a.vx;
103:       a.y += a.vy;
104:       // wrap
105:       if (a.x < -a.r) a.x = width + a.r;
106:       if (a.x > width + a.r) a.x = -a.r;
107:       if (a.y < -a.r) a.y = height + a.r;
108:       if (a.y > height + a.r) a.y = -a.r;
109:       // collision with ship
110:       if (dist(a, ship) < a.r + ship.r) {
111:         gameOver = true;
112:       }
113:     }
114:     // check orbs
115:     for (const o of orbs) {
116:       if (!o.collected && dist(o, ship) < o.r + ship.r) {
117:         o.collected = true;
118:         score += 10;
119:         ship.fuel = Math.min(100, ship.fuel + 20);
120:       }
121:     }
122:     // remove collected orbs and occasionally spawn new ones
123:     if (orbs.filter(o => !o.collected).length < 3) spawnOrb();
124:     // spawn new asteroids over time
125:     if (Math.random() < 0.01) spawnAsteroid();
126:   };
127: 
128:   const draw = () => {
129:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
130:     // ship
131:     ship.draw();
132:     // asteroids
133:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
134:     for (const a of asteroids) {
135:       ctx.beginPath();
136:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
137:       ctx.fill();
138:     }
139:     // orbs
140:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
141:     for (const o of orbs) {
142:       if (o.collected) continue;
143:       ctx.beginPath();
144:       ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
145:       ctx.fill();
146:     }
147:     // HUD
148:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
149:     ctx.font = '14px sans-serif';
150:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
151:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${Math.round(ship.fuel)}`, 10, 40);
152:     if (gameOver) {
153:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
154:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
155:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
156:       ctx.font = 'bold 32px sans-serif';
157:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
158:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
159:     }
160:   };
161: 
162:   const loop = () => {
163:     update();
164:     draw();
165:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
166:   };
167: 
168:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
169: })();
